commands.command:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop devices backing srv_data_vg LVM PVs
DefaultDependencies=no
After=local-fs-pre.target systemd-udevd.service
Before=sysinit.target
Requires=local-fs-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/losetup -fP /srv/lvmbacking/disk1.img
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/losetup -fP /srv/lvmbacking/disk2.img
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/udevadm settle
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/vgchange -ay srv_data_vg

[Install]
WantedBy=sysinit.target
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable srv-data-loop.service
